court: In the High Court of Madras
case_number: TR CMP No. 1334 of 2024 and CMP No. 28769 of 2024
prayer: Prayer: This Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petition filed under Section 24 of Civil Procedure Code, to withdraw the case in O.S. No. 19 of 2023, pending on the file of the Family Court, Tirupur and transfer the case to the file of the Family Court, Tiruvannamalai to be tried along with O.S. No. 6 of 2024.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr A.D. Maria Clete, J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the prayer sought for by the petitioner in this Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petition has become infructuous and he has also made an endorsement in the petition to that effect.

2. In view of the submission and endorsement made by the learned counsel for petitioner, this Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petition is dismissed as infructuous. Consequently, connected C.M.P. No. 28769 of 2024 is closed. There shall be no order as to costs.
